notes.title: Freedom Fall Update: Hard Mode + 2 new levels
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

Just wanted to let you all know that an update for the game should be out soon! The update will include the following:

- Two new levels - Bombard and Chainmoor
- Hard mode available
- Extra posters from the princess to find in secret areas
- New Princess chase area in Electrified
- Improved performance in Garden and Sharkie levels
- More traps are destroyable or responsive to bombs
- New achievements

If you have any issues with the update please let us know!

- The Stirfire Team

notes.title: Getting your Steam key from Desura
notes.content:
If you previously bought the game on Desura (either directly, or via the Indie Royale or Groupees bundles) you can get your Steam key this way:

[list]
[*] Log into [url=http://www.desura.com]Desura[/url]
[*] Go to your [url=http://www.desura.com/collection]collection[/url]
[*] Click on "Keys" in the second column of that table in the line that has Freedom Fall. 
[/list]

notes.title: Freedom Fall launched!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

The Stirfire Team here, wanting to thank everyone who voted for us while we were on Greenlight and helping us get Greenlit! 

We are so happy to announce that we have launched Freedom Fall today and to celebrate this we have put a 35% discount on the purchase of the game!

For people who have bought Freedom Fall previously on Desura and bundles, Steam keys will be distributed to you soon!

Happy gaming everyone!

- The Stirfire Team
